invariants.rationale: Parallelism typically represents a number of threads or partitions and should be positive.
The input list 'data' should not be null for processing.
It is generally reasonable to limit parallelism to no more than the amount of available data.
If data is present, it should not be empty to justify parallel processing.

meta.value: data not empty if not null

invariants.rationale: The value of parallelism is bounded above by Integer.MAX_VALUE, its type limit.
